communications.subject: Charge inquiry - TXN-955547661
communications.body:
Hi,

I noticed a charge of $150 on my statement from Subscription Box Co. I would like to understand this charge and request a resolution.

Regards,
Eleanor Vance

communications.subject: RE: Charge inquiry - TXN-955547661
communications.body: I contacted Subscription Box Co via their online customer support chat on February 7, 2026. I explained the discrepancy and provided my account details. The representative, 'Sarah,' claimed that my latest box included a 'special, limited-edition item' which resulted in the higher charge, stating it was part of a promotional offering. However, I was never informed about such an item, nor did I opt-in to receive it. When I pressed for clarification, 'Sarah' simply reiterated that the charge was valid according to their internal records and would not offer a partial refund or adjustment.
